text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O seems tired, so I suggest we go for a walk. Soon enough, we're stopped by a few fans.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Thank you for your gracious support! I shall return all your favor with… an opera of gratitude!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… D-did you see their beaming faces? My brilliance has come through once again!
choice_data_list: Isn't it exhausting to perform an opera each time you want to thank your fans?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Noblesse oblige. Even in the most inclement of weather, the sun must rise to bring light to the world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On top of her races, her efforts to please her fans are taking a toll on her. Maybe I should adjust her racing schedule.
